name: City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, February 07, 2017 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation - Mayor Waronek
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
Prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CITY MANAGER'S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-g, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular meeting held on January 17, 2017
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #7b
c.
Approve the Demands and Payroll
ACTION: That the demands and payroll be received and filed.
Item #7c
d.
Approval of Final Map for Tract Map No. 73112
ACTION: That the City Council approve final map for Tract Map No. 73112, as recommended by the City Engineer's consultant HR Green.
Item #7d
e.
Approve amendment to the Professional Services Agreement between the City of Lomita and Caja Environmental Services for the Picerne Lomita Apartment Project
ACTION: That the City Council authorize the City Manager to approve an amendment to the agreement between the City of Lomita and Caja Environmental Services, LLC for a revised fee of $164,000.
Item #7e
f.
Adopt the Sewer System Management Plan Five-Year Update and Recertification
ACTION: That the City Council adopt the updated Sewer System Management Plan (SSMP); and authorize the Public Works Director to certify the updated SSMP and submit the SSMP and all required documentation to the State of California
Item #7f
g.
Approve submittal of Watersmart Grant application
RES.
2017-01 - A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, AUTHORIZING THE CITY MANAGER TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE UNITED STATES BUREAU OF RECLAMATION FOR THE WATERSMART PROGRAM, SUPPORTING THE APPLICATION SUBMITTED AND CERTIFYING THAT FUNDS ARE AVAILABLE FOR THE HARBOR HILLS HOUSING ADVANCED METERING PROJECT.
ACTION: Adopt the resolution; and authorize the City Manager or his designee to submit Resolution No. 2017-01 and any other required grant application documentation to the Bureau of Reclamation or other appropriate federal agency.
Item #7g
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
CONSIDERATION OF CHANGING THE GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION DATES TO COMPLY WITH STATE LAW
Presented by City Attorney Hogin And City Manager Smoot
ORD No. 784 - AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF LOMITA AMENDING SECTION 201.30 (GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION DATES) OF CHAPTER 1 (CITY COUNCIL PROCEDURE) OF TITLE II (ADMINISTRATION) OF THE LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE CHANGING THE DATE OF THE CITY'S GENERAL MUNICIPAL ELECTION FROM THE FIRST TUESDAY AFTER THE FIRST MONDAY IN NOVEMBER OF EACH ODD-NUMBERED YEAR TO THE FIRST TUESDAY AFTER THE FIRST MONDAY IN NOVEMBER OF EVEN-NUMBERED YEARS BEGINNING IN NOVEMBER 2018. (First Reading)
ACTION: That the City Council in accordance with Senate Bill 415, consolidate the City's next general municipal election date with the November 2018 statewide election (note this will increase councilmember terms by 12 months); and that after the City Attorney reads the title , the City Council introduce on first reading an ordinance amending Section 2-1.30 (General Municipal Lection Dates) of Chapter 1 (City Council Procedure) of Title II (Administration) of the Lomita Municipal Code changing the date of the City's general municipal election from the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November of each odd-numbered year, to the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November of even-numbered years, beginning in November 2018.
Item #8
9.
DISCUSSION OF STRATEGIC PLANNING WORKSHOP AND MID-YEAR BUDGET REVIEW
Presented by City Manager Smoot
10.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council meeting be adjourned in memory of Mary Ann Andersen to the next Regular Meeting to be held on Tuesday, February 21, 2017, at 6:00 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
